summary: Iteration 26 — Case 5 WhatsApp templates + message tracking. Backend (14/14 pytest) and Frontend (all critical selectors + navigation) verified. Webhook HMAC-signed status update (sent -> delivered) works. Live WA send succeeded (real wamid) so lifecycle tracker is exercised end-to-end. Regression (RBAC export 403, reports/dashboard, follow-ups list, gmail auth-url) still green.
critical_code_review_comments: wa_tracking.py: lead_messages endpoint has no pagination (limited to 50 hard-coded); acceptable for MVP but consider ?page/limit like template_messages if templates get spammy on hot leads.
templates.py PATCH update_template accepts arbitrary dict body — good field-whitelist is applied, but consider returning 400 when body is empty/no allowed keys instead of silently no-op $set.

record_wa_outbound stores app_secret-free wamid path; when send fails the wamid is null which means webhook can never re-attach a status. Consider persisting the client_message_id and matching against status.recipient_id + timestamp as fallback.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 draft/approved templates named 'TEST_iter26_wa_tpl' (ids 222 & 223) and one 'New WhatsApp Template' (id 224 from UI flow). One live-sent wa_tracking record on lead 500154 (phone 9811100095) exists with real wamid and status delivered (via webhook test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: WhatsApp Cloud credentials in preview are actually valid — live sends return real wamid and can be advanced through the lifecycle by posting HMAC-SHA256 signed webhook payloads to /api/webhooks/whatsapp using settings.whatsapp_cloud.app_secret. GET /api/admin/settings returns a dict keyed by settings-key (NOT a list) — use s['whatsapp_cloud']['app_secret'] directly. Template 222 (TEST_iter26_wa_tpl) has 1 tracked message (track_id=1, status=delivered).
